description: This file defines the 'menu' class within the 'gui' namespace, representing a GUI widget for a scrollable menu with sorting and item management features. It includes class definitions, member functions, and data structures related to menu items, sorting, and event handling.

classes.name: menu
classes.description: A GUI scrollable menu widget supporting item management, sorting, and user interaction.

classes.name: menu::item
classes.description: Represents an individual menu item with fields, help text, and an ID.

classes.name: menu::sorter
classes.description: Abstract base class for sorting behavior of menu items.

classes.name: menu::basic_sorter
classes.description: Concrete implementation of sorter supporting various sorting modes.

methods.name: menu
methods.description: Constructor for the menu class, initializing with video context, items, and optional sorting.

methods.name: selection
methods.description: Returns the currently selected item's index.

methods.name: move_selection
methods.description: Moves the selection to a specified item ID, optionally moving the viewport.

methods.name: change_item
methods.description: Changes the text of an item at specified positions.

methods.name: erase_item
methods.description: Removes an item at the specified index.

methods.name: set_heading
methods.description: Sets the header labels for the menu columns.

methods.name: set_items
methods.description: Updates the menu items and redraws the menu.

methods.name: set_max_height
methods.description: Sets the maximum height of the menu.

methods.name: set_max_width
methods.description: Sets the maximum width of the menu.

methods.name: double_clicked
methods.description: Checks if the last action was a double click.

methods.name: set_click_selects
methods.description: Enables or disables selection on click.

methods.name: set_numeric_keypress_selection
methods.description: Enables or disables numeric keypress selection.

methods.name: scroll
methods.description: Scrolls the menu to a specified position.

methods.name: sort_by
methods.description: Sorts items based on a specified column.
